summary: Self-service password reset by email for registered customers, with a time-limited link, no account enumeration and a password length policy.
requirements: Sign-in page exposes a password reset entry point.
Reset link is emailed to registered addresses and expires after 30 minutes.
Response does not reveal whether an email is registered.

acceptance_criteria.text: A "Forgot password?" link is shown on the sign-in page.
Submitting a registered email sends a reset link valid for 30 minutes.
Submitting an unregistered email shows the same confirmation message (no account enumeration).
The new password must be 12-64 characters long.

findings.text: Behaviour when a reset link is used twice is not specified.
Are existing sessions invalidated after a successful reset?

risks.title: Account enumeration
risks.description: Different responses or timings for registered vs unregistered emails reveal account existence.

assumptions: Email delivery is available in the test environment (mail catcher).
